content_html:
watched #DearZindagi : what a movie……Gauri Shinde is bang on Target!!!! If English Vinglish was all about an House Wife, this is all about a young girl (whow we all encounter in our daily life as any of our sibiling, cousin, friend, collegue or girl friend etc) who cant take decisions………

SRK : This year he proved again who is the Badshah of acting in Bollywood…..another auperb performance from him after Fan. I havent seen such a matured and impact performance from him after Chak De & Swadesh!!! n the way he created space for Alia to perform….Man the combination of SRK n Alia was treat to watch!!!

Aaaliaaaaa : the wonder kid of Bhatt shaabh!!! after RGV she is the only one for whom i can have a argument with anyone 🙂 all the way i went to watch Alia in the film….but what i was shocked to see was there was no Aliaa…..its KAIRA!!! she makes you laugh on her, feel pitty for her, get irriated by her, cry with her….for the first time I have seen SRK to come up with extra ordinary performance to match to his costar (after amitabh)!!! while she can do all these kind of Highway, Udtha & Dear Zindagi roles…she is just 23!!!

Music has been really good & situational….esp songs and lyrics were awesome

on end note…..would love to watch RGV & Alia working together soon!!!
